author: GameTrailers
description:
Featuring new game announcements and exclusive trailer reveals, watch this livestream of the third annual DevGAMM Awards, celebrating new AA and indie games.

Broadcast live from DevGAMM Lisbon, the ceremony brings together 70 nominees from 25 countries and special guests to reveal the winners across 12 main categories, sharing a $100,000 prize pool sponsored by Scorewarrior.

An additional $40,000+ in cash and prizes will be awarded across special categories sponsored by Epic Games Store, Unreal Engine, Godot, tinyBuild, and Unity.

Don't miss this celebration of the indie scene!
 
Learn more: https://devgamm.com/awards2026/
title: DevGAMM Awards 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Hutuo Gameplay Trailer for Where Winds Meet, the hit open-world action RPG developed by Everstone Studio. Players can get a look at the new region coming to the game named Hutuo, filled with new places to explore and enemies to dispatch along the way. Explore the Hutuo region on November 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Where Winds Meet - Official Hutuo Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Everlen: The Volgran Torment, a tactical third-person bullet-hell sci-fi action roguelike developed by Goblin Studios. Players will traverse procedurally generated environments to face ancient Gods and seek out the secrets of a living celestial body. Everlen: The Volgran Torment is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Everlen: The Volgran Torment - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Magnetaris DLC Release Date Trailer for The Planet Crafter, the hit space open-world survival game developed by Miju Games. Players will be able to set off onto an uncharted planet with electrical storms and magnetic fields alike with the next DLC. Traverse the new biome and face unknown anomalies with the Magnetaris DLC for The Planet Crafter, launching on December 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, GOG, and Xbox on PC).
title: The Planet Crafter - Official Magnetaris DLC Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
A new update brings three new missions to Better Than Dead. Check out the latest Better Than Dead trailer for this single-player bodycam FPS inspired by Hong Kong action cinema to see what to expect from the new update, which adds three missions that complete To Hell, the game's first full run. Better Than Dead is available now in Early Access on PC, and Update 0.500 is out now.

Set in 1990s Hong Kong, the new missions take players through a nightclub’s cramped corridors, a sprawling restaurant shootout where tables and furniture splinter under fire, and an unfinished construction site filled with exposed concrete and scaffolding.
title: Better Than Dead - Official Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Hillthorn, an adventure Lovecraftian detective puzzle adventure game developed by Fool Moon and Finnegan Motors. Players will embody an investigator with a peculiar disappearance and limited time to solve the case. Solve the mystery without a single spoken word in Hillthorn, available now for Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Hillthorn - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Conan: The Black Pyramid, an upcoming action roguelite RPG set in Robert E. Howard's shared universe. Conan: The Black Pyramid will be available on PC via Steam in 2027.

In Conan: The Black Pyramid, something is pulling legends out of their own centuries. Conan, Solomon Kane, Dark Agnes and other heroes wake up inside the Black Pyramid, a labyrinth that ignores the rules of space and time and changes with every descent. Each run gets them a little closer to the question at its centre: who summoned them here?
title: Conan: The Black Pyramid - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Android Launch Trailer for GigaBash, the hit action kaiju fighting game developed by Passion Republic Games. Players will take on the most powerful of kaiju inspired by hit action films. Destroy the city on the go in GigaBash, available now on Android, alongside PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: GigaBash - Official Android Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for Dandy's World, a mascot horror survival game on Roblox. The new trailer showcases the release date for the 1.0 update, which brings a new game mode and more. The 1.0 update will feature a new game path with over 10 new floors where players explore the deepest and darkest floors of the Gardenview Center, new gameplay systems, and new lore and dialogue that explores the origins of Gardenview and the events leading up to the mysterious Malfunction Incident.

Dandy's World 1.0 update will be available on November 20, 2026.
title: Dandy's World 1.0 - Official Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Becoming the Captain Gameplay Trailer for The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, an upcoming third-person action RPG developed by Owlcat Games. Players can get an extended look at the Polly Mission with a look at social dialogue, intense combat gameplay among the stars, and more. The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is launching in 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn - Official Becoming the Captain Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Beta Gameplay Overview Trailer for Exterminauts, a co-op third-person PvE shooter developed by Behaviour Interactive. Players can get the rundown on what to expect from the upcoming beta, including how to approach missions, what equipment to bring, and an extended look at gameplay. Exterminauts is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with the beta launching on November 12 for Steam.
title: Exterminauts - Official Beta Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Step into the world of Thveit and check out gameplay in this new trailer for the upcoming cozy Norse settlement builder game, where changing seasons, ancient beliefs, and folklore creatures shape the fate of your settlements. Guide your settlers, manage resources, and grow a thriving community as humans and mythical beings learn to live side by side. Thveit will be available on Steam. You can sign up for the playtest if you're interested.
title: Thveit - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Season 3 Trailer for Wardogs, the hit first-person multiplayer action shooter developed by Bulkhead. Players can take on a new map, Sabatulo, taking the fight to a bustling city with key locations to explore. Engage with a new game mode, multi-track unlocks, and more with the arrival of Season 3 for Wardogs, launching on November 12 for PC (Steam).
title: Wardogs - Official Season 3 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Closed Playtest Gameplay Trailer for Westlanders, an upcoming survival action-adventure game developed by The Breach Studios. Players will take on the unforgiving Wild West alone or with friends to assemble settlements, take on enemies, and create an everlasting legacy. Westlanders is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a closed playtest available now on Steam.
title: Westlanders - Official Closed Playtest Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay from Prinny Party: Going Overboard! in this launch trailer for the party game that sees you and your friends fight classic Disgaea protagonists—and each other. In Prinny Party: Going Overboard!, move around the board, buy weapons, upgrade facilities, and pass bills to get stronger, then fight, steal, and torment your friends! Only the player who delivers the defeated Protago-knights gets credit, so do whatever it takes to make sure you're the victor!

Prinny Party: Going Overboard! is available now on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC (Steam).
title: Prinny Party: Going Overboard! - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Dark Machine The Game, the upcoming multiplayer mech action shooter developed by Dark Machine Project and Liona Inc. Players will command powerful war machines in a plethora of modes to reign victorious. Take out structures, hold choke points, and unload fury against the opposition. Dark Machine The Game is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a beta playtest running from December 18 through December 25.
title: Dark Machine The Game - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Season 11 Battle Pass: The Incursion Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based action shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can get a look at the new rewards to earn through progression in the latest Battle Pass, with new skins for Iron Man, Wolverine, Daredevil, Ultron, and more. The Season 11 Battle Pass launches on November 13 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Season 11 Battle Pass: The Incursion Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Shell Squad Update Launch Trailer for TMNT: Splintered Fate, the hit action roguelike game developed by Super Evil Megacorp. Players will join forces with the power of co-op, making its way to the game with new trenchcoat outfits, and more improvements to explore. The Shell Squad Update for TMNT: Splintered Fate is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Official Shell Squad Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for A Snail's Tale, a retro RPG with a twist. Have you heard the one about the million dollars and the immortal snail? A Snail's Tale will let you play out the story and answer the question once and for all: can he be stopped? 

In A Snail's Tale, take on the role of Samson Spligglebarp, an aspiring warrior swept into King Phillippe’s bizarre predicament: an immortal snail that will never stop pursuing him. As Samson ventures through a mysterious fantasy world, he’ll encounter eccentric characters, unconventional foes, and a comedic adventure where even the slowest creature can become the biggest problem.

A Snail's Tale is available on Nintendo Switch and Steam today, November 11, 2026.
title: A Snail's Tale - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Introducing Othercrown, a deckbuilding auto-battler roguelite where you play as the villain. Your army lives on your slot reels, and each card you draw becomes a symbol within your slot machine. Through it, you deploy spells and monsters during battles and work towards the craziest builds. Maximise the efficiency of your slots and deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: http://steampowered.com/app/5217270?utm_source=press-release-reveal
title: Othercrown: Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Eagle's Shadow Update Launch Trailer for War Thunder, the hit vehicular action combat game developed by Gaijin Entertainment. Players can gain access to a new fleet of vehicles to rain hellfire on the battlefield with the F-15EX, Leopard 2A8, the Fulmar Mk.II, and more improvements and features to enjoy. The Eagle's Shadow Update is available now for War Thunder on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Windows, Mac, Linux).
title: War Thunder - Official Eagle's Shadow Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Knockout Expansion Class Trailer for Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor, the hit action horde defense game developed by Funday Games. Players can take a look at the latest offerings in the Knockout Expansion, including the new Brawler Class, the new Sandblasted Corridors biome, the daunting Brood Harvest mission, and more. The Knockout Expansion is launching on November 17 for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Official Knockout Expansion Class Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Mistfall Hunter Season 2: Fires of the Past in this trailer for the new season of the dark-fantasy extraction action RPG. Season 2 of Mistfall Hunter brings a new seasonal stage mode featuring the Wildfire Forbidden Zone on the Hallowgrove map, a new boss, a new weapon school, and S1-driven improvements to class balance, latency, loot availability, quests, camp upgrades, and warehouse management. Mistfall Hunter Season 2: Fires of the Past is available now on PC (Steam and Microsoft Store), PlayStation, and Xbox, including day one on Xbox Game Pass.
title: Mistfall Hunter Season 2: Fires of the Past - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Console Launch Trailer for Thronefall, a city-building minimalist tower defense game developed by GrizzlyGames and Mythwright. Players will assemble a bustling economy and kingdom to ensure its defense, make use of a suite of playstyles, and explore 10 maps with new challenges along the way. Thronefall is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Thronefall - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the 'To The Sky' Update Launch Trailer for Active Matter, the hit extraction first-person shooter developed by Matter Team. Players can get a look at the latest update, with the Vanilla skyscraper becoming accessible. Take on new enemies, make use of new vehicles, and wield powerful weapons to seek out the secrets of the Icarus Corporation. The 'To The Sky' Update is available now for Active Matter on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Active Matter - Official 'To The Sky' Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Thronefall trailer to see what to expect from the Craaghelm DLC, which brings new maps, new battles, new enemies, new units, new weaponry and tools, and more to the minimalist strategy game. Ride into battle to build and defend your mini medieval kingdom in Thronefall. Build an empire across the mountainous Nordfels to the vibrant Wildbach in the base game, and gather your forces for all-new battles in Craaghelm. Thronefall is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox Game Pass. It is also available on PC, mobile, and Nintendo Switch. The Craaghelm DLC for Thronefall is also out now on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. The DLC is coming soon to Nintendo Switch.

Defend your little dwarven kingdom from a mighty mechanical army and reclaim your ancestral halls in Craaghelm. Call upon ancient heroes and rally new forces as you descend into the mountain, exploring eight new maps to expand your reign.

Command powerful new units, including Axe Throwers, A
title: Thronefall - Official Craaghelm DLC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this exclusive gameplay demo for Alpha Channel and Kepler Interactive's vehicular action game! In a hostile world, humankind has found ways to digitise their consciousness, to travel out into the world to scavenge for supplies. Those that explore the world are known as Sleepwalkers. We join Mike Brown, Design Director at Alpha Channel Games, as he takes us through the new Ironstrike mission, customisation and weaponry for your tank, the Cableworm boss fight, and the all-new Remote-Viewer, a new ability that lets you hijack enemies turning their weaponry against their allies! 

TankRat is coming to PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5 on January 15th 2027!
title: TankRat - Exclusive Extended Gameplay Demo

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at pirate mayhem in this latest trailer for Last Pirates: Die Together, a comedic online co-op adventure for up to 4 players. You and your crew use wobbly, stretchy arms to haul as much treasure as possible back to your captain. Break down doors, snatch every coin in sight, and survive the monsters, the traps, and each other's terrible decisions along the way. Last Pirates: Die Together is available now on Xbox Series X/S in Game Preview and supports Xbox Play Anywhere and crossplay with the Steam version. It is also out now in Steam Early Access.
title: Last Pirates: Die Together - Official Xbox Game Preview Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Wall World Strategy is available now on Steam. Watch the Wall World Strategy launch trailer for this colony sim on a sheer vertical surface, where every decision affects the stability of the system. In Wall World Strategy, build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.
title: Wall World Strategy - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The Devil’s Due is available now on Steam. Check out the launch trailer for The Devil’s Due, a strategy roguelike deckbuilder game. In The Devil's Due, you lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.
title: The Devil’s Due - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the gameplay trailer for JIAOHUN, a first-person psychological horror game from 12AM BLACKOUT. Set in 1999, just before the arrival of the new millenium, you explore Fairy Town, a town caught between changing tides. Step into the darkness and learn the truth at the heart of Fairy Town's downfall. 

JIAOHUN launches on PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027!
title: JIAOHUN - Official Gameplay Trailer
